text: RESOLVED: Provenance carries a ContentHash of its inputs alongside the parameter record. Rationale: settled by inspection -- Provenance as designed records smoother, bandwidth, grid, measure and seed but NO input identity, so two different datasets analysed identically have equal provenance and different results. It cannot be a cache key alone. Use a fast non-cryptographic digest (xxHash-style) over numeric payload plus geometry, computed once at ingest, memoized, and identical on JVM and JS per DET-2. Not cryptographic: this is cache invalidation, not a security boundary. This is the join point with repro4s. New bead: k-contenthash.
